collections.name: Credits in Motion
collections.description:
Credits in Motion is an independent animated pixel-art experiment inspired by the visual language of Jack Butcher’s Credits.
10,000 unique compositions. Each artwork is constructed pixel by pixel — individual blocks appear in sequence, gradually assembling into the final piece before the cycle begins again.
Every composition and assembly sequence is unique.
But this collection is about more than movement.
50% of mint proceeds and 50% of creator fees are dedicated to supporting children through Adam Weitsman and Make-A-Wish.
This continues a charitable initiative I previously started with DROUPZ, a collection created by me. Through DROUPZ, donations from the project were directed to Make-A-Wish through Adam Weitsman.
With Credits in Motion, that idea continues:
Pixels move. Kindness continues.
Independent project. Inspired by Credits. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Jack Butcher or the original Credits collection.

collections.name: Trace Art
collections.description:
Its characters begin in 3D, where their forms and traits are designed and assembled. Custom-built tools then transform them into ASCII portraits composed entirely of letters, numbers, and symbols.

You won’t see your character right away. Each artwork begins in an encoded form, using one of three methods to record the symbols that make up its portrait: Punched card, Base64, Binary.

The result is an abstract record of the portrait, without preserving the original arrangement of its symbols. Every stage stands on its own as a finished artwork. You can choose to keep it as it is or explore what comes next.
